tools.name: open_now
tools.description: Tables bookable right now at the hardest restaurants in New York, San Francisco, Los Angeles and Chicago, with exact times, across Resy, OpenTable, Tock and SevenRooms. Use this when someone asks what they can get tonight or this week. Changes by the minute.

tools.name: restaurant_intel
tools.description: The measured booking record for one restaurant: how often a two-top and a four-top are actually open, how many dates were checked, its booking window and release hour. Use this to answer whether a restaurant is realistically gettable, or why someone keeps failing to book it. Figures are measured fro

tools.name: when_does_it_release
tools.description: When a restaurant puts new dates up and how far ahead it books. Give a dining date to get the exact day and local time that date becomes bookable. Use this for 'when can I book X for Saturday' or 'when do X reservations open'. Each restaurant sets its own hour and window, so the answer is per restau

tools.name: hardest_tables
tools.description: The hardest restaurants to book in a city, ranked by how rarely a table is actually reachable, measured rather than opinion. Use this for 'what are the hardest reservations' or to set expectations.

tools.name: last_table_spotted
tools.description: The most recent table SnagRes saw open anywhere, with the time it was spotted. Use it to show the service is live, or as a sense of what is moving right now.
